answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor that emits a periodic signed beacon; miss one and accrued standing decays. Trust climbs a terrace of tenure levels only when several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign your audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet is a faint nebula: every beacon traces back to that single anchor, endorsements never span distinct clusters, and the clones stall on the lowest terrace. A farm buys a distinct anchor per head (linear) while an honest agent pays once.
